reference: Original manifest M0 Tnone ordered sample pose/time sequence, never inferred from matching IDs/CRC
recursive_certificate: Equal sequence lengths, complete ordered row-by-row pose/time/bodyyaw/antenna-relation pass; finite values and monotone time; H rows match pose rows. No nearest-neighbor remapping or visit reuse for recursion.
on_failed_certificate: Recursive BLOCKED_INPUT; retain row failures and compare only geometrically matched static poses, no heading/replay claim
static_matching: All original M0 pose candidates within 3D position and wrapped body-yaw tolerances; deterministic earliest candidate used only for static RF comparison. Preserve ambiguity count, reference time and selected index. Static matching never certifies clock alignment.
height_contract: Use explicit z column, or independently documented fixed robot height supplied with metadata evidence path; missing height blocks 3D matching
observer: Pinned SourceFFD O.observe, same 257 frequencies, Hann 4N strongest RX30percent/common tap; no reconstructed alternate observer
missing_los: Zero-energy/nonfinite native LoS row excluded from paired LoS differences and explicitly recorded; never synthesize LoS
if_certificate_pass_recursive_scope: Mother runtime: R4/R5 A/B x M0/M45 x B0/L2 x POWER1/JOINT4; x10-16V1/V2 heading and skip; this preparation runner does not execute EKF
independence: Existing corridor only; repeated positions/visits are not independent scenes; no p-value
